name: Clinic supply par levels and expiry check
summary: From the clinic's own stock-count and usage exports, the person who orders supplies gets a par level and reorder point for every item in every room, what is below par, what will expire before it is used, and a draft order. Medical-surgical and office supplies only; a person approves every order.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own design: the limit to medical-surgical and office supplies with everything else listed as out of scope; room-by-room work from stock-count, usage and item-list exports with set column headers that stop on a mismatch; daily use counted per open day; a par covering the days between orders, the supplier's delivery time and a buffer; the lot-by-lot, whole-unit count of how much of each lot will be used before its expiry date; a draft order net of open orders, rounded to supplier packs, with an approval line; and surplus in other rooms shown but never subtracted.

sources.contribution: A par as the amount each location is filled back up to at every restock, sized from average daily use over the days it must last plus a buffer in days of use; earliest-date-first handling of lots with a value on stock that will be lost; a warning period before expiry; a refill trigger ahead of the regular restock; a stock-out read as a sign of a low par; and moving surplus or short-dated stock to where it is used faster.
